name: muster
description: Muster is a self-hosted back office for projects, clients, invoices, knowledge, assets, and delivery records, wired into Claude Code. Agents read and update the same records people use, over MCP.

directus_url.title: Board URL
directus_url.description: Directus base URL of the board, e.g. https://cms.musterr.dev

directus_token.title: Board API token
directus_token.description: Directus static token for your board. Stored in your OS keychain. The default is the public read-only token for the musterr.dev demo board, so /muster:connect needs no arguments. The first MCP tool call still asks you to approve it. Replace this token when you point at your own board.
